questions.title: 这么大的黑洞，会把整个星系吃掉吗？
questions.text: 不会因为它在中央，就让所有恒星都掉进去。绕行的运动很重要；整个星系的引力还来自恒星、气体和暗物质。太靠近的物质可能被捕获，气体还需要把角动量向外传递才能持续流入。可以研究星系怎样给中央供气，却不能把整座星系画成必然被吸进一个漏斗。
questions.action: 在“恒星路过黑洞”章比较飞掠与瓦解：先找两条命运从哪里分开。

questions.title: 观测到的最小黑洞是什么样？
questions.text: 先问：这是已确认的黑洞，还是低质量候选？GW230529 的较重成员估计为 2.5–4.5 个太阳质量（90%可信区间），较可能是黑洞，但不能完全排除中子星。若把它作为无自旋黑洞，视界直径约 15–27 km。这是从引力波推断质量再计算的尺寸，不是直接拍到的照片，也不把它称为已确认的最小纪录。

questions.title: 理论上还能更小吗？
questions.text: 恒星坍缩形成黑洞的条件，不是所有理论黑洞的尺寸下限。原初黑洞是假想的早期宇宙产物，可以讨论远小于恒星级的质量，但目前没有确认发现。经典公式把更小质量对应到更小视界；极小尺度还涉及蒸发与量子引力，不能据此宣布一个已证实的“最小黑洞”。
questions.source: NASA · 黑洞类型与原初黑洞

questions.title: 如果没有亮盘，我们怎么找到它？
questions.text: 找它对周围东西的影响。Gaia BH1 是附近的一个例子：我们看见伴星的运动，再推断有一个不发出可见星光的大质量伴随天体。不同黑洞的证据还可能来自炽热气体、恒星轨道或并合引力波；没有亮盘不等于没有黑洞。

questions.title: Could a huge black hole eat a whole galaxy?
questions.text: Being at the centre does not make every star fall in. Orbital motion matters, and stars, gas and dark matter also contribute to a galaxy's gravity. Material passing too close may be captured; gas must transport angular momentum outward to sustain an inward flow. We can study how a galaxy supplies its centre, but should not show the whole galaxy inevitably draining into a funnel.
questions.action: Compare the flyby and disruption in the stellar-encounter chapter. Find where their outcomes separate.

questions.title: What does the smallest observed black hole look like?
questions.text: First ask: confirmed black hole or low-mass candidate? GW230529's heavier member is estimated at 2.5–4.5 solar masses (90% credible interval). A black hole is more likely, but a neutron star cannot be completely ruled out. If treated as a non-spinning black hole, its horizon would be about 15–27 km across. Mass is inferred from gravitational waves and size is then calculated, not photographed. This is not labelled a confirmed smallest record.

questions.title: Could there be even smaller ones in theory?
questions.text: The conditions for stellar collapse are not a size limit for every theoretical black hole. Primordial black holes are hypothetical early-universe objects and could have far less than stellar masses, but none has been confirmed. The classical formula assigns smaller horizons to smaller masses. At very small scales, evaporation and quantum gravity matter, so it cannot establish a proven smallest black hole.
questions.source: NASA · Black-hole types and primordial holes

questions.title: How can we find one without a bright disk?
questions.text: Look for its effects on other things. Nearby Gaia BH1 is an example: astronomers measure a companion star's motion and infer a massive companion with no visible starlight. Evidence for other black holes can include hot gas, stellar orbits or gravitational waves from mergers. No bright disk does not mean no black hole.
